cultural.vision_reason: This is a classic Palauan carved and painted storyboard depicting a legendary scene (bridge crossing, canoes, sailboats, villagers bearing taro), a genre unique to Palauan culture and matching the museum description closely.

physical.title: storyboard
physical.summary: Storyboard of wood, paint. Depicts a bridge with ascending figures: on the left a man (all male figures in red loincloths) approaches holding a fish, with four female figures wearing red skirts with black waistbands and holding red bowls of taro; in the centre two figures face each other holding black circular objects; three male figures ascend from the right, holding red paddles.  Under the bridge are two red canoes, each with three male figures holding paddles, and separated by a small island with two trees. Below the canoes are five fish and one turtle.  Either side of the bridge are two large palms. To the right of the bridge are two bai (houses) painted in yellow, black, red, white and brown, with a yellow sun and and a red bird above. On background of black.
